name: Haldwani
pointBasis: Immutable pending-queue WUP 2025 City_Code 9127 coordinate, copied without adjustment.
registryBasis: The Nainital district administration links to the Uttarakhand Bhulekh public Record of Rights/Khata-Khatauni portal; Board of Revenue Uttarakhand lists Bhulekh and BhuNaksha as revenue applications. This establishes official record custody and service routes, not the public availability of parcel geometry or title conclusions.
blocker: The public land-record portal and state BhuNaksha entry point did not return a usable anonymous response during this review. The separate public registration GIS configuration advertises administrative, village, road, and village-union layers; its configured MapServer hosts did not respond to the direct HTTPS metadata requests. No claim of parcel-data absence is made.

source.layer: Viewer JavaScript names UK_admin MapServer (visible layer IDs 0-2), UK_stamp_reg MapServer/2 (village), /1 (road), and /4 (village_union); these are not documented as parcel layers

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official district/state land-record links and the configured state registration/rate GIS service family were reviewed. These establish revenue record custody and expose administrative/village-related GIS layers, but no anonymous cadastral parcel layer was verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous source-native full parcel geometry and a stable parcel identifier remain unverified in this pass. The WUP point was not used to infer source absence; city and state coverage remain unknown.

technicalBlocker: Current anonymous parcel-geometry access is unknown. Escalated public-network retries to the official Bhulekh, BhuNaksha, and configured map-service endpoints timed out before HTTP responses. No absence conclusion is supported.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Uttarakhand Bhulekh or BhuNaksha endpoints expose anonymous parcel geometry, whether another state parcel service exists, and whether any parcel layer covers Haldwani remain unverified. The public registration GIS configuration does not identify the listed admin/village/road/village-union layers as parcel layers.

portals.operator: District Administration Nainital, Government of Uttarakhand
portals.scope: The district's Bhulekh/Khata-Khatauni page directs users to the Uttarakhand public RoR portal and lists a tehsil-level land-record service center. It is an official land-record route, not evidence of a downloadable geometry API.
The Board's official homepage lists Bhulekh and BhuNaksha as separate revenue applications. This supplies the state-specific BhuNaksha endpoint `https://bhunaksha.uk.gov.in/`.

portals.operator: Department of Land Resources / National Informatics Centre, Government of India
portals.scope: The national Bhu-Naksha product description says the parcel-map management system is intended for authorized state/UT officials and requires a valid user ID to enter. This is documentation of the product's access model, not a test proving that the Uttarakhand public endpoint lacks geometry.

portals.operator: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Uttarakhand
